> **搜索技巧**:如果用户的查询只指定了任务名称(例如“完成任务龙虾一号”),请直接使用 `+get-my-tasks --query "龙虾一号"` 命令搜索(不要带 `--complete`
> **用户身份识别**:在用户身份(user identity)场景下,如果用户提到了“我”(例如“分配给我”、“由我创建”),请默认获取当前登录用户的 `open_id` 作为对应的参数值。
> **友好输出**:在输出任务(或清单)的执行结果给用户时,建议同时提取并输出命令返回结果中的 `url` 字段(任务链接),以便用户可以直接点击跳转查看详情。

- [`+tasklist-task-add`](./references/lark-task-tasklist-task-add.md) — Add existing tasks to a task

content.user_title: Manage Lark Tasks and Task Lists
content.value_statement: Lark task work can be hard to track across comments, assignees, reminders, and task lists. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code manage Lark tasks through lark-cli with clear confirmation steps.
actual_capabilities: Create Lark tasks with summaries, descriptions, assignees, due dates, and task list placement.
Search and list the current user's tasks by name, completion status, creation time, or due date.
Update task summaries, descriptions, due dates, completion state, and reopen completed tasks.
Add comments, assignees, followers, and reminders to existing Lark tasks.
Create task lists, add existing tasks, and manage task list members.
Preview task creation payloads with dry-run before creating a task.
limitations: Requires lark-cli to be installed and authenticated before use.
Requires Lark task and task list scopes granted to the active identity.
Write operations should not run until the user confirms the exact change.
The skill depends on Lark API behavior and may fail if IDs or permissions are invalid.

use_cases.title: Organize personal work
use_cases.description: Find assigned Lark tasks, review due dates, and complete or reopen tasks after confirmation.

use_cases.title: Coordinate project delivery
use_cases.description: Create project task lists, assign owners, add deadlines, and keep task links visible for follow-up.

use_cases.title: Maintain team task hygiene
use_cases.description: Update task membership, followers, reminders, and comments so collaborators have current task context.

prompt_templates.title: Create a task
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lark task called "Prepare Q3 review" for me, due Friday. Confirm before running any write command.

prompt_templates.title: Find my tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my Lark tasks that mention onboarding and show due dates, status, and task links.

prompt_templates.title: Update collaboration
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Li Wei as an assignee and set a one hour reminder for task t_123. Confirm the exact changes first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a launch list
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Launch Checklist task list with tasks for copy review, legal approval, and release notes. Assign owners and confirm before executing.

output_examples.output: Found three incomplete tasks. The response lists each task name, due date, owner, and Lark link.

output_examples.input: Create a tasklist for launch work.
output_examples.output: The skill confirms the tasklist name, members, and tasks first. After approval, it reports the new tasklist ID and link.

output_examples.input: Add a reminder to task t_123.
output_examples.output: The skill asks for confirmation, applies the reminder through Lark, and reports whether the update succeeded.

best_practices: Confirm every create, update, complete, reopen, assignment, membership, reminder, and comment action before execution.
Use task IDs, task list IDs, and open IDs returned by Lark instead of guessing values.
Include due dates, owners, and task links in user-facing summaries when available.
anti_patterns: Running write commands before the user confirms the exact task and requested change.
Using app identity for current-user task searches that require a user identity.
Sending unsupported fields without checking the Lark CLI schema for native API calls.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Lark tasks, task lists, assignees, followers, reminders, comments, and task status through lark-cli.

faq.question: Does it create tasks automatically?
faq.answer: It can create tasks, but write operations should run only after the user confirms the exact action.

faq.question: Can it find tasks assigned to me?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search the current user's tasks by summary, completion state, creation time, and due date.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The environment must have lark-cli installed, authenticated, and granted the required Lark task scopes.

faq.question: Can it manage task lists?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create task lists, add tasks to lists, and add, remove, or replace task list members.

faq.question: Is this skill useful for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides command guidance that Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can use when lark-cli is available.
